# Comb-p

Identification of differentially methylated regions (DMR) using comb-p


```{r combp, results="verbatim"}
# Run comb-p, run!!
Sys.setenv(PYTHONPATH="/home/chuffarf/opt/combined-pvalues/")
cmd = "/home/chuffarf/opt/combined-pvalues/cpv/comb-p"
arg = paste0("pipeline --step 100 -c 5 --seed ", pval_thresh, " --dist 1000 -p dmrcombp_", prefix,"_", prefix3, " --region-filter-p 0.05 --region-filter-n 3 ", bed_ewas_filename)
print(paste(cmd, arg))
system2(cmd, arg)
```

```{r, eval=nrow(results)>0}
print("# # annotate dmr")
tmpidx = order(results[,"z_sidak_p"])
results = results[tmpidx,]
rownames(results) = paste0(results[,1], ":", results[,2], "-", results[,3])
rownames(results) = paste0("DMR", 1:nrow(results))
results = cbind(results[,1:3], id=rownames(results), len=results[,3] - results[,2], strand="+", results[,4:ncol(results)])
head(results)
```


```{r dmr_indexed_probes, eval=nrow(results)>0}
# beta version, need to integrate dnamaging feature 
# devtools::install("~/projects/dnamaging")
source("~/projects/dnamaging/vignettes/common.R")
print("# # dmr_indexed_probes")
pf = pf[!is.na(pf[[pf_chr_colname]]),]
pf = pf[pf[[pf_pos_colname]]>0,]
pf = pf[order(pf[[pf_chr_colname]],pf[[pf_pos_colname]]), ]
## index meth probes by chr
chrs = unique(pf[[pf_chr_colname]])
chrs_indexed_methpf = lapply(chrs, function(chr) {
  print(chr)
  idx = rownames(pf)[!is.na(pf[[pf_chr_colname]]) & pf[[pf_chr_colname]]==chr]
  ret = pf[idx,]
  return(ret)
})
names(chrs_indexed_methpf) = chrs

dmr_indexed_probes = epimedtools::monitored_apply(results, 1, function(feat) {
  # feat = results[1,]
  # print(feat)
  chr = feat[[1]]
  len = as.numeric(feat[[3]]) - as.numeric(feat[[2]])
  meth_platform = chrs_indexed_methpf[[chr]]
  ret = dmprocr_get_probe_names(feat, meth_platform, pf_chr_colname, pf_pos_colname, 0, len)
  # meth_platform[ret,1:3]
  # feat
  return(ret)
})
```


```{r effect_by_dmr_from_ewas, eval=nrow(results)>0}
results$ewas_pv     = NA
results$ewas_effect = NA
for (ff_id in rownames(results)) {
  if (nrow(results)>1 & !is.matrix(dmr_indexed_probes)) {
    p = intersect(dmr_indexed_probes[[ff_id]], rownames(ewas_orig))
  } else {
    p = intersect(dmr_indexed_probes[,ff_id], rownames(ewas_orig))
  }
  results[ff_id, ]$ewas_pv     = signif(10^-mean(ewas_orig[p,2], na.rm=TRUE), 3)
  results[ff_id, ]$ewas_effect = signif(mean(ewas_orig[p,1], na.rm=TRUE), 3)
}
head(results)
```





```{r annotate dmr, eval=nrow(results)>0}
genome = "hg38"
results$genome=genome
# annotatr
tmp_results_filename = paste0("dmrcombp_", prefix, "_", prefix3, ".bed")
print(tmp_results_filename)
write.table(results[,1:6], file=tmp_results_filename, sep="\t", quote=FALSE,row.names=FALSE, col.names=FALSE)
dm_regions = annotatr::read_regions(con=tmp_results_filename, genome=genome, format="bed")
# Build the annotations (a single GRanges object)
annotations = annotatr::build_annotations(genome=genome, annotations=paste0(genome, c("_basicgenes")))
# Intersect the regions we read in with the annotations
dm_annotated = annotatr::annotate_regions(
    regions = dm_regions,
    annotations = annotations,
    ignore.strand = TRUE,
    quiet = FALSE)
# A GRanges object is returned
df_dm_annotated = data.frame(dm_annotated)
# dedup
df_dm_annotated$annot.type = factor(df_dm_annotated$annot.type, levels=paste0(genome, c("_genes_promoters", "_genes_1to5kb", "_genes_5UTRs", "_genes_exons", "_genes_introns", "_genes_3UTRs")))
table(df_dm_annotated$annot.type)
table(df_dm_annotated$name)
df_dm_annotated = df_dm_annotated[order(df_dm_annotated$name, df_dm_annotated$annot.type),]
df_dm_annotated = df_dm_annotated[!duplicated(paste(df_dm_annotated$name, df_dm_annotated$annot.symbol)),]
dim(df_dm_annotated)
table(df_dm_annotated$annot.type)
# aggregat by fat_feat
fat_feat_annotations = lapply(unique(df_dm_annotated$name), function(n) {
  # n = "chr7:2661785-2662169"
  foo = df_dm_annotated[df_dm_annotated$name==n,]
  if (sum(df_dm_annotated$name==n) == 1) {
    return(foo)
  } else {
    foo[["annot.symbol"]] = paste0(foo[["annot.symbol"]],collapse=";")
    foo[["annot.type"]] = paste0(foo[["annot.type"]],collapse=";")
    foo[["annot.tx_id"]] = paste0(foo[["annot.tx_id"]],collapse=";")
    return(foo[1,])
  }
})
fat_feat_annotations = do.call(rbind, fat_feat_annotations)
rownames(fat_feat_annotations) = fat_feat_annotations$name
head(fat_feat_annotations)
rownames(fat_feat_annotations) %in% rownames(results)
rownames(results) %in% rownames(fat_feat_annotations)
# inject into results
results$annot.type   = NA
results$annot.symbol = NA
results$annot.tx_id  = NA
for (idx in rownames(fat_feat_annotations)) {
  results[idx,"annot.type"  ] = as.character(fat_feat_annotations[idx,"annot.type"  ])
  results[idx,"annot.symbol"] = as.character(fat_feat_annotations[idx,"annot.symbol"])
  results[idx,"annot.tx_id" ] = as.character(fat_feat_annotations[idx,"annot.tx_id" ])
}

results$nb_probes = NA
results$probes = NA


for (idx in rownames(results)) {
  if (nrow(results)>1 & !is.matrix(dmr_indexed_probes)) {
    idx_probes = dmr_indexed_probes[[idx]]
  } else {
    idx_probes = dmr_indexed_probes[,idx]
  }
  results[idx, "nb_probes"] = length(idx_probes)
  results[idx, "probes"] = paste(idx_probes, collapse=";")
}

results_filename = paste0("dmrcombp_", prefix, "_", prefix3, ".xlsx")
print(results_filename)
WriteXLS::WriteXLS(results, results_filename, FreezeCol=6, FreezeRow=1, BoldHeaderRow=TRUE, AdjWidth=TRUE)
```

# Volcano plot wity DERs

```{r volcano}
idx_probes = unlist(strsplit(results[,]$probes, ";"))
xlim = range(ewas_orig[idx_probes,1])
ylim = range(ewas_orig[idx_probes,2])
layout(1, respect=TRUE)
plot(ewas_orig, xlab="meth. diff.", ylab="-log10(raw_pval)", col=adjustcolor("grey", alpha.f=0.1), pch=16, xlim=xlim, ylim=ylim)
for (i in 1:nrow(results)) {
  col=i
  idx_probes = strsplit(results[i,]$probes, ";")[[1]]
  points(ewas_orig[idx_probes,]                                      , col=adjustcolor(col, alpha.f=.3), pch=16)
  segments(ewas_orig[idx_probes,1], ewas_orig[idx_probes,2], mean(ewas_orig[idx_probes,1]), mean(ewas_orig[idx_probes,2]), col=adjustcolor(col, alpha.f=.5), pch=16)
  points(mean(ewas_orig[idx_probes,1]), mean(ewas_orig[idx_probes,2]), col=adjustcolor(col, alpha.f=.6 ), pch=16, cex=3)
  text(mean(ewas_orig[idx_probes,1]), mean(ewas_orig[idx_probes,2]), rownames(results)[i], col=1)  
} 
```

```{r figs4res, eval=nrow(results)>0}
library(Biostrings)
library(Rsamtools)

get_CpG_positions <- function(fasta, chr, start, end) {

  seq <- scanFa(
    path.expand(fasta),
    GRanges(chr, IRanges(start, end))
  )[[1]]

  # UCSC genome.fa is soft-masked (repeats in lowercase): upper-case first,
  # otherwise matchPattern("CG") misses CpGs inside masked regions
  seq <- DNAString(toupper(as.character(seq)))

  hits <- matchPattern("CG", seq)

  # Return an empty data.frame when no CpG is found, instead of failing
  if (length(hits) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(chr = character(), start = integer(),
                      end = integer(), CpG = character()))
  }

  data.frame(
    chr   = chr,
    start = start(hits) + start - 1,  # genomic position of the C (1-based)
    end   = start(hits) + start,      # genomic position of the G
    CpG   = as.character(hits)
  )
}
if (nrow(results) > 0) {
  for (i in rownames(results)[1:min(nrow(results),20)]) {

    plot_res(
      roi,

      ewas=ewas,
      pheno_key=pheno_key, # rownames(attr(stats::terms(as.formula(model_formula)), "factor"))[2],

      study_filename=study_filename
    )
    e = s$exp_grp
    idx_ctrl  = rownames(e)[e[[pheno_key]]%in%levels(e[[pheno_key]])[1]]
    idx_case  = rownames(e)[e[[pheno_key]]%in%levels(e[[pheno_key]])[2]]

    layout(c(1,1,2,2,3,4))
    par(mar=c(0, 5.1, 4.1, 2.1))
    plot (s$platform[idx_probes,2], s$platform[idx_probes,]$lpv                          , ylab="-log10(raw_pv)", xaxt="n", typ="b", pch=16, main=i)
    abline(h=-log10(as.numeric(pval_thresh)), col=1, lty=2)
    abline(v=(floor(min(s$platform[idx_probes,2])/100):ceiling(max(s$platform[idx_probes,2]/100))*100), col=adjustcolor("grey", alpha.f=.3))
    legend("topright", col=1:3, levels(as.factor(e[[pheno_key]])), pch=16)
    par(mar=c(0, 5.1, 0, 2.1))
    matplot(s$platform[idx_probes,2], s$data[idx_probes,], type="l", col=adjustcolor(as.numeric(as.factor(e[[pheno_key]])), alpha.f=.3), lty=1, ylab="norm counts", xaxt="n")
    abline(v=(floor(min(s$platform[idx_probes,2])/100):ceiling(max(s$platform[idx_probes,2]/100))*100), col=adjustcolor("grey", alpha.f=.3))
    # lines(s$platform[idx_probes,2], apply(s$data[idx_probes,idx_HD ], 1, mean), col=1, type="b", lwd=3, pch=16)
    lines(s$platform[idx_probes,2], apply(s$data[idx_probes,idx_ctrl  ], 1, mean), col=1, type="b", lwd=3, pch=16)
    lines(s$platform[idx_probes,2], apply(s$data[idx_probes,idx_case  ], 1, mean), col=2, type="b", lwd=3, pch=16)
    # plot(s$platform[idx_probes,2], s$platform[idx_probes,]$diff, ylim=range(0, s$platform[idx_probes,]$diff), ylab="Diff. meth.", xaxt="n")
    # abline(v=(floor(min(s$platform[idx_probes,2])/100):ceiling(max(s$platform[idx_probes,2]/100))*100), col=adjustcolor("grey", alpha.f=.3), ylab="meth. diff.")
    par(mar=c(5.1, 5.1, 0, 2.1))
    fasta = "~/projects/datashare/genomes/Homo_sapiens/UCSC/hg38/Sequence/WholeGenomeFasta/genome.fa"
    chr = s$platform[idx_probes,1][1]
    start = min(s$platform[idx_probes,2]) - 100
    end = max(s$platform[idx_probes,2]) + 100 
    cpgs = get_CpG_positions(fasta=fasta, chr=chr, start=start, end=end)
    plot(s$platform[idx_probes,2],rep(0, length(idx_probes)), yaxt="n", ylab=paste0("CpG in\n", genome), col=0, xlab=s$platform[idx_probes,1][1])
    points(cpgs[,3],rep(0, nrow(cpgs)), yaxt="n", ylab="CpG")
    abline(v=(floor(min(s$platform[idx_probes,2])/100):ceiling(max(s$platform[idx_probes,2]/100))*100), col=adjustcolor("grey", alpha.f=.3))
    par(mar=c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 2.1))

  }
}
```
